reproduction_script:
from pathlib import Path
from argparse import Namespace
import json

from benches.launch import configure
from benches.runtime import manifest, server
from benches.workload import generate

root = Path('/workspace/orbitkv')
reference = root / 'benches/results/runs/queued-warming-sglang-off'
output = Path(__file__).parent
source = json.loads((reference / 'manifest.json').read_text())
args = Namespace(**source['arguments'])
args.model = Path(args.model)
args.output = output
args.backend = 'native'
args.ssd_gib = 0
args.query_budget_gib = None
args.trace_transfers = False
prefix = json.loads((reference / 'prefixes.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()[11])
launch = configure(args, source['kv_bytes_per_token'])
record = {'manifest': manifest(args, launch, source['kv_bytes_per_token']),
          'prefix': prefix, 'source_run': str(reference),
          'reproduction_script': Path(__file__).read_text()}
samples = [json.loads(line) for line in (reference / 'samples.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
record['orbitkv_samples'] = [s for s in samples if s.get('prefix_index') == 11]
with server(launch.command, launch.env, launch.base_url, output / 'engine.log'):
    record['native_cold'] = generate(launch.base_url, args.engine, str(args.model), prefix['tokens'], args.output_tokens)
    record['native_hbm'] = generate(launch.base_url, args.engine, str(args.model), prefix['tokens'], args.output_tokens)
    (output / 'control.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert record['native_cold']['usage']['cached_tokens'] == 0
    assert record['native_hbm']['usage']['cached_tokens'] > 0
record['cold_matches_seed'] = record['native_cold']['text'] == prefix['reference']['text']
record['hbm_matches_cold'] = record['native_hbm']['text'] == record['native_cold']['text']
record['cached_orbitkv_match_native_hbm'] = all(s['text'] == record['native_hbm']['text'] for s in record['orbitkv_samples'] if s['cached_tokens'] > 0)
record['uncached_orbitkv_match_native_cold'] = all(s['text'] == record['native_cold']['text'] for s in record['orbitkv_samples'] if s['cached_tokens'] == 0)
record['cached_orbitkv_count'] = sum(s['cached_tokens'] > 0 for s in record['orbitkv_samples'])
(output / 'control.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print({key: record[key] for key in ('cold_matches_seed', 'hbm_matches_cold', 'cached_orbitkv_match_native_hbm', 'uncached_orbitkv_match_native_cold')}, flush=True)
